_comment: Copy to agyhq.config.json (repo root) and edit, or point --config / AGYHQ_CONFIG at a copy elsewhere. Every field is optional — anything omitted falls back to a sensible default (see packages/server/src/config.ts).
_comment_phase2: Phase 2: inbound/outbound email. email.kind: "none" (default) | "maildir" (local dev/testing) | "imap-smtp" (real mailbox). imap/smtp passwords here are overridden by AGYHQ_IMAP_PASS / AGYHQ_SMTP_PASS env vars if set — prefer the env vars and leave "pass" out of the file.
_comment_facebook: Fanpage Manager (docs/FANPAGE.md). facebook.kind: "none" (default) | "fake" (in-memory Page, offline, for trying the role) | "graph" (the real Page via the Graph API). Secrets are NEVER written here (an accessToken / appSecret field is a load error): the Page token comes from env AGYHQ_FB_PAGE_TOKEN (tokenEnv can name another variable) and the optional app secret from env AGYHQ_FB_APP_SECRET, like AGYHQ_IMAP_PASS / AGYHQ_SMTP_PASS; with the secret set every call carries appsecret_proof, which is what allows turning on Require App Secret in the app dashboard. appId is not secret and goes here. apiVersion has no default on purpose. scheduleLeadHours: approved posts are scheduled at least this far ahead (so a human can still cancel them in Meta Business Suite). appMode is informational (the Graph API does not report it). Run `hq facebook doctor` after filling this in.

sender.name: Your Company Sales
sender.companyAddressLine: Your Company, 123 Main St, City, Country

_comment_webhooks: Per-source shared secret checked via header x-agyhq-webhook-secret on POST /v1/inbound/webhook/:source. Example: { "typeform": { "secret": "change-me" } }
